description: Turn the approval-review flow on or off for an existing collection (requested=true to request review, false to cancel). Use this to enable review/annotation on a collection that was published without it - review is a property of the collection, so there is no need to re-publish a copy to get it. To LEAVE review once the work is done, prefer end_review, which checks the threads are resolved first.

collectionId.description: collection_id is the collection to toggle review on.

requested.description: requested turns the approval-review flow on (true) or off (false).

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

name: set_review
title: Turn review on or off
